item.title: on responsive design
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Short post: responsive design is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Responsive design shows up across web work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: responsive design, revisited
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
A quick write-up on responsive design, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Responsive design shows up across web work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: on responsive design
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I spent a while getting responsive design wrong. Here is the version that works for me.

why it matters

Responsive design shows up across web work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
